answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in terrace and shale lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the quill graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1134 impostors cost 252 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
